jobs.title: Java Developer, Lead
jobs.description:
Java Developer, Lead**The Opportunity:**


Every day, millions of Americans depend on medical devices to protect their health and save their lives. As a senior Java Developer on this team, you'll build and modernize the systems that support medical device review for a federal public health agency. Using modern architectures, frameworks, and agile practices, you'll deliver production\-ready solutions that reduce review timelines, strengthen IT resilience, and retire legacy risk.


This role goes beyond writing code. You will lead design and delivery for modernization workstreams. You will set standards, including code quality, testing, CI/CD, production and readiness, mentor developers, and drive quality and technical decisions. You will own production support escalation path for critical issues. You will evaluate emerging tools and techniques, recommend system improvements, and ensure your solutions account for the broader architecture, operating environment, and long\-term scalability.


Ready to build systems that will change medical device review for the better?


Join us. The world can't wait.

**You Have:**

* 8\+ years of experience in software development
* 6\+ years of experience with Java, including Spring Boot, Hibernate or JPA, and RESTful web services
* 4\+ years of experience leading engineers, including mentoring, code review ownership, and delivery accountability
* 3\+ years of experience with a modern JavaScript framework such as React.js, Vue, and Angular.js, including responsive, accessible UI development
* Experience leading or co\-leading modernization or migration of large legacy Java applications such as monolith to modular services or modern frameworks
* Experience with database design, including writing and optimizing SQL such as Oracle or PostgreSQL
* Experience working with legacy Java technologies, including J2EE, JSP, or Servlets, developing migration strategies to modern frameworks, and providing production support and issue resolution
*

jobs.title: Mid-Level Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Description**


Are you ready to build software that makes a real\-world impact? Leidos is seeking a talented Mid\-Level Full Stack Software Engineer to join the Chinook Program supporting an Intelligence Community customer. In this role, you’ll design, develop, and deliver modern software solutions that enable critical national security missions while working alongside some of the industry’s brightest engineers, architects, and mission experts.


As a Full Stack Engineer, you’ll contribute across the entire software development lifecycle, from crafting intuitive user interfaces to building scalable backend services and integrating secure, cloud\-native solutions. Working within a collaborative Agile environment, you’ll help deliver high\-quality capabilities through iterative development, continuous integration, and DevSecOps best practices.


In this role, you will work on cross\-functional development teams to build and maintain microservices, APIs, and web\-based applications that support GEOINT data access, visualization, and dissemination. You will contribute to the full software lifecycle and will have the opportunity to work directly with users, cloud engineers, and mission stakeholders.


If you’re passionate about solving complex technical challenges, learning emerging technologies, and developing software that directly supports mission success, this is an exciting opportunity to grow your career while making a meaningful difference.


Position may be performed in the following locations below. Please note Gaithersburg, MD is the program’s primary work location.

* Alexandria, VA

* Tucson, AZ

jobs.title: Principal Micro Services Architect
jobs.description:
Job Description
  
  

ACTIVE SECURITY CLEARANCE AT THE TS/SCI POLYGRAPH LEVEL IS REQUIRED
  
  

In this role, you will play a central role in designing, building, and deploying scalable end\-to\-end applications that transform massive datasets into mission\-critical power. You will own everything from developing middle\-tier services to backend data storage, building robust ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) pipelines, implementing micro\-services architectures, and integrating corporate authentication services into secure full\-stack applications. Working in an agile, fast\-paced environment equipped with modern cloud and containerization tools like Docker and Kubernetes, you’ll turn complex data constraints into sleek, reliable engineering solutions. If you love solving messy backend challenges and take pride in rock\-solid code, Team Nyla wants you building with us!
  
  

The annual base salary range for this role is $216,000\-$256,000 (USD) , which does not include discretionary bonus compensation or our comprehensive benefits package. Actual compensation offered to the successful candidate may vary from posted hiring range based upon geographic location, work experience, education, and/or skill level, among other things.
  
,

**Java Full\-Stack Development:** Extensive experience in full\-stack Java development, including middle\-tier logic, JavaScript front\-end integration, and backend data storage design.
  
  

**Core Languages \& Scripting:** Strong hands\-on coding proficiency in Java, JavaScript, and Python.
  
  

**ETL \& Large\-Scale Data Handling:** Proven capability in building and optimizing Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) data pipelines and delivering full\-stack solutions tailored for large datasets.
  
  

**Microservices \& Local Caching:** Strong experience developing within micro\-services frameworks and implementing local caching services for performance optimization.
  
  

**Containerization, CI/CD \& DevOps:** Hand

jobs.title: OSS Engineer (US - Remote)
jobs.description:
AXON Networks delivers a robust AI\-driven, analytics\-based orchestration platform and a wide portfolio of next\-gen high\-speed routers that leverage the newest Wi\-Fi technologies. Together, these technologies give ISPs the ability to manage and troubleshoot their networks in real time, and to deliver an outstanding customer experience.



AXON Networks is a trusted strategic partner for its customers, helping them evaluate their current technologies and business models, and creating and executing strategies that enable them to innovate faster, accelerate their digital transformations, and strengthen their relationships with consumers.



AXON Networks is headquartered in Irvine, CA USA with Asia HQ in Singapore and also operating in Denmark, Spain and Vietnam.



The OSS Engineer will design, build and operate the Operations Support Systems (OSS), dashboards, data products and workflow automations that enable Network Operations to support cloud solutions and large fleets of customer\-premises equipment (CPE), including broadband gateways, routers, ONTs and connected\-home devices. This is a hands\-on software and systems role for an engineer who understands how NOCs, service assurance, fault and performance management, device operations and service\-provider support work in practice.



Reporting to the Network Operations Manager, you will turn repetitive work and fragmented operational data into secure, maintainable capabilities used by the NOC, Support and Operational Excellence teams. You will partner with cloud, DevOps, firmware, QA, Database Engineering, Product and Security, while remaining close to the operators who use the tools every day.



**Role mandate**
----------------



* Own the engineering lifecycle for internal OSS tools, operational dashboards, workflow automations and integrations assigned to the role.
* Translate the team’s pain points, controls and support needs into reusable, product\-like capabilities—not disconnected one\-off scripts.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
**What Impact You'll Have**

GRVTY is seeking a Data Engineer to join an agile development team. The team builds and maintains ETL pipelines that enable full spectrum data operation from ingest to query exceeding current and expected business value requirements. As an individual contributing member of the team, you will participate in our agile development process and will work with modern tools and technologies, and you will be encouraged to stay up to date with the latest developments in the field. You will be part of a dynamic and collaborative team that is committed to delivering high\-quality solutions to our clients. The work environment is a hybrid one, with a mix of remote and in\-person work. If you are a self\-motivated, creative, and detail\-oriented software engineer who is passionate about developing innovative software solutions, we would love to hear from you.



**What You'll be Owning**

* Must have a strong working knowledge and experience developing ETL Pipelines
* The ideal candidate will have worked with big data systems, complex structured and unstructured data sets, and have supported government data acquisition, analysis, and/or sharing efforts in the past
* To excel in the position, the candidate shall have a strong attention to detail, be able to understand technical complexities, and have the willingness to learn and adapt to the situation
* Should have an inquisitive nature, responsiveness, and excellent testing and quality assurance skills.
* Must also possess strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to work under pressure with multiple deadlines.
* Will work in a fast\-paced, small business environment independently and with our talented team.
* Other duties as assigned.

**What You Must Have**

* Must have a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience.
* BS in Engineering, Computer Science, or technical degree or industry experience equivalent
* Current Active Top Secret Clearance, SCI eligible.
